claims.text: Celiac trunk: gives rise to the left gastric, common hepatic and splenic arteries.
claims.quote: the celiac trunk gives rise to the left gastric, common hepatic, and splenic arteries.

claims.text: Common hepatic artery: forms the hepatic artery, the right gastric artery and the cystic artery (to the gallbladder).
claims.quote: Common hepatic artery Branch of the celiac trunk that forms the hepatic artery, the right gastric artery, and the cystic artery
claims.locator: Table: Vessels of the Abdominal Aorta

claims.text: Superior mesenteric artery: supplies the small intestine, the pancreas and most of the large intestine.
claims.quote: Superior mesenteric artery Branch of the abdominal aorta; supplies blood to the small intestine (duodenum, jejunum, and ileum), the pancreas, and a majority of the large intestine
claims.locator: Table: Vessels of the Abdominal Aorta

claims.text: Inferior mesenteric artery: supplies the distal large intestine and rectum.
claims.quote: Inferior mesenteric artery Branch of the abdominal aorta; supplies blood to the distal segment of the large intestine and rectum
claims.locator: Table: Vessels of the Abdominal Aorta
